text:
Priya: FYI we started getting SCIM 400s from Azure for tenant 'acme-corp' after we enabled LB http/2 + mTLS on idp endpoints. Error in payload: 'unsupported chunked encoding'. anyone run into this?
Sam: do you have a req id and a sample request?
Priya: req id 1b2c3d, curl we used: 
```
curl --http2 --cert client.pem:pass --key client.key -X POST "https://scim.redwood.example/Users" 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/scim+json' 
  --data-binary @user.json
```
-> immediate 400 with body: 'client sent chunked body but upstream disabled chunked'
Lia: azure's SCIM client will speak http/2 when ALPN+mTLS available. HTTP/2 doesn't use Transfer-Encoding: chunked the same way; proxies sometimes translate poorly to http/1.1 upstreams and leave chunked markers.
matt: @Priya confirm our proxy config? nginx edge accepts h2 and proxies to go-service (http/1.1). we recently toggled proxy_http_version and chunked_transfer_encoding options during LB change.
Priya: correct. upstream is go-service over 1.1. our nginx had chunked_transfer_encoding off globally which seems to confuse this path.
Sam: short fix: route-level override to force proxy_http_version 1.1 and enable proxy_request_buffering so edge fully reads body and sends a normal non-chunked request upstream. That avoids leaking h2 framing as chunked markers.
Priya: deploying canary (scim-route) with proxy_request_buffering=on and proxy_http_version=1.1 at 5% now.
deploy-bot: Deploy started for scim-proxy v2026.04.01-canary at 1799005225
Sam: can we capture a tcpdump of client->edge and edge->upstream for a failing request? want to compare pseudo-headers and final upstream bytes.
Priya: grabbed a short dump: client->edge shows h2 frames, :method POST, no content-length. edge->upstream (before fix) shows Transfer-Encoding: chunked and chunk markers; upstream go-service returns 400.
Lia: confirm mitigation: buffering + forcing 1.1 should produce a Content-Length header to upstream and no chunked encoding. Also add an ingress test that simulates Azure AD SCIM over mTLS+h2 in CI.
matt: opening INF-8482 to track integration test + postmortem + runbook update.
Priya: canary metrics: 5% -> 100% in 12m, errors dropped to baseline. rolling the config to prod. I'll add a runbook note: "SCIM upstreams: prefer http/1.1 or ensure app supports h2 streaming semantics; if using h2 at edge, enable proxy_request_buffering for SCIM routes."
Sam: nice triage. also add a small unit test in go-service to reject chunked bodies explicitly so we catch regressions.
Priya: thanks everyone. logging INF-8482 and will attach tcpdumps to the ticket.
